name: Bad Kleinkirchheim
description: Bad Kleinkirchheim is one of Carinthia’s largest and most popular ski resorts. With 103 kilometers of slopes, 35 slopes, and 24 lifts nestled amid impressive mountain panoramas, it offers winter sports fun for all skill levels. After a day of skiing, the Therme Römerbad invites you to relax with its spacious wellness areas, warm thermal pools, and a sauna complex—unique in Carinthia—featuring 13 saunas and steam baths—perfect for a varied winter vacation.
